protocol_authority: SymC General Operations Manual v0.8.0 plus GRI project-local guardrails
purpose: Materialize the already-frozen chronic SCC25 G2 D1 point operators and audit discrete-to-continuous embedding readiness without assigning a restoration operator or computing normalized G1.
allowed_operations: validate the immutable G2 artifact identity and frozen result contract
re-materialize only the D1 point-fit transition matrix T from the same hash-bound source and frozen construction
verify the re-materialized T reproduces the frozen point rho and sigma_max diagnostics to strict numerical tolerance
compute eigenvalues and a principal-branch matrix-log candidate where numerically possible
report reconstruction error, eigenvector conditioning, real/imaginary matrix-log components, and branch non-uniqueness
write a diagnostic artifact that cannot supersede the frozen G2 result
forbidden_operations: change preprocessing, feature selection, rank, transition geometry, model family, or G2 thresholds
replace, rescore, or reinterpret the frozen G2 result
assign common or gene-specific restoration or degradation rates
select a matrix-log branch because it improves a downstream biological result
compute, admit, tune, or classify Chi_bio
use distance to unity for model, branch, normalization, gate, or stopping selection
claim that a weekly discrete-time mathematical boundary is a biological unity boundary
